standard_prerequisites.name: The small and big etale sites and their projections
standard_prerequisites.statement: The projection pi_X from the big etale site of algebraic spaces over X to the small etale site X_etale, the comparison map a_X of topoi, and the identity f_small = pi_X o i_f for f : Y -> X.
standard_prerequisites.use: It fixes the notation of the statement and is the identity used in the first step (source lines 749-755 and 761-763).

standard_prerequisites.name: The ph topology and its equalizer criterion
standard_prerequisites.statement: A presheaf on the big etale site is a sheaf for the ph topology exactly when every surjective proper morphism V -> U of algebraic spaces over X gives an equalizer diagram of its sections (Topologies on Spaces, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It reduces the ph part of the proof to the equalizer statement at source lines 767-774.

standard_prerequisites.name: The author's lemma on proper coverings
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a surjective proper morphism V -> U of algebraic spaces over X the sections of pi_X^{-1}F form the equalizer of the two projections (the author's lemma-surjective-proper, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the input of the ph reduction at source line 774.

core_obligations: Compute the pullback: transitivity of pullback with f_small = pi_X o i_f gives i_f^{-1} pi_X^{-1}F = f_small^{-1}F, whence the displayed description of pi_X^{-1}F (source lines 761-764).
Reduce the ph sheaf condition to the equalizer condition for a surjective proper V -> U over X, citing the cross-chapter criterion and the retained chapter lemma (source lines 767-774).
Deduce the smooth, syntomic and fppf cases from the ph case (source lines 777-779).
Treat fpqc coverings in the three cases the author distinguishes, schemes / U a scheme / general, reproducing the two verifications the author explicitly leaves to the reader (source lines 782-796).

proof_roadmap.step: Transitivity of pullback plus f_small = pi_X o i_f yields the description of pi_X^{-1}F.
Reduce the ph sheaf condition to the equalizer condition for a surjective proper cover, using the cited criterion and the retained chapter lemma.
Smooth, syntomic and fppf coverings follow from the ph case.
fpqc coverings are handled in three cases, with the author's two omitted verifications kept verbatim.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-describe-pullback at source lines 747-758: for a sheaf F on X_etale the pullback pi_X^{-1}F is computed on Y by Gamma(Y_etale, f_small^{-1}F), and it satisfies the sheaf condition for smooth, syntomic, fppf, fpqc and ph coverings. The author's proof at source lines 760-797 first obtains the description from transitivity of pullback together with f_small = pi_X o i_f, then reduces the ph part to an equalizer computation for a surjective proper V -> U (one same-chapter result retained as context plus one cross-chapter criterion declared as a tagged pointer), transfers the smooth, syntomic and fppf cases from the ph case, and finally treats fpqc coverings in three cases (U and the U_i schemes; U a scheme; the general case) in which the author explicitly omits two verifications. The counted argument is therefore a complete multi-step reduction whose every in-chapter ingredient is retained inside the package.
